tense_late.when: Close game, late innings. The quiet register - level 20 to 35.
lines: We're one swing away from absolute chaos.
Nobody breathe.
This place is about to explode.
Everything changes right here.
One pitch writes tomorrow's headline.
This is baseball at its absolute best.
Buddy... this ain't pressure. This is history knocking.
This stadium is holding its breath.
Nobody move.
You can feel it.
One pitch.
He knows it. The pitcher knows it. Thirty thousand people know it.

lines: Buddy... that baseball just filed a change-of-address form to the upper deck!
That pitcher just donated another souvenir to the bleachers!
Holy hell! That baseball left the stadium before the outfielder even blinked!
You can kiss that baseball goodbye!
That baseball's got frequent-flyer miles now!
He hit that ball so hard it owes air traffic control an apology!
That baseball is applying for citizenship in the parking lot!
That wasn't batting... that was aggravated assault on a baseball!
That baseball got hit so hard even the pigeons ducked!
That baseball's gonna need a passport after that ride!
Good LORD... somebody call NASA!
That baseball just entered witness protection!
He just hit that baseball into next Tuesday!
That swing just committed a baseball felony!
The catcher didn't catch that one... he watched it leave the county!
That baseball just paid tolls leaving the stadium!
That baseball's orbiting the moon!
That baseball got absolutely vaporized!
That baseball just entered low Earth orbit!
I've seen fireworks with a softer launch than that!
That baseball just entered the Smack Hall of Fame!
MOON MISSILE!

pitcher_shelled.when: Pitcher getting hit hard, hanging pitches, bullpen leaking.
lines: That fastball had all the stopping power of wet toilet paper.
Buddy just threw premium batting practice.
That pitcher just turned into a full-time souvenir supplier!
That pitch had one destination... getting absolutely murdered!
You can't throw cookies to hungry hitters!
I've seen bowling balls break more than that breaking ball!
That curveball curved directly into unemployment!
That pitcher is serving meatballs with extra gravy!
This pitcher's getting shelled like free peanuts at a ballpark!
That's what happens when you leave steak in the strike zone!
That pitch was hanging like grandma's laundry!
That bullpen's leaking runs like a busted garden hose.
Buddy just hung a meatball with premium shipping.
That pitch had 'hit me' written all over it.
That inning's gonna haunt his ERA for a month.

shut_out.when: Losing side scored nothing, or close to it. No offence at all.
lines: That team couldn't hit water if they fell out of a boat.
Their bats were on airplane mode all night.
That lineup swung like they were blindfolded.
That team couldn't buy a hit with Monopoly money.
Somebody call animal control... those bats are extinct.
Their bats were colder than a January toilet seat.
That lineup had less life than a dead phone battery.
You can't win games scoring imaginary runs.
That team looked like they were allergic to home plate.
That offense couldn't start a lawn mower.
I've seen batting cages with tougher competition.
Somebody put milk cartons on that offense... they're missing.
Nine innings and not a single run. That's a goose egg with a bow on it.
Somebody check that lineup card... half of it never left the dugout.

collapse.when: Blew a lead, fell apart, lost one they had won.
lines: Buddy... y'all just invented a new way to lose.
They didn't lose... they got evicted from the game.
Their comeback had the lifespan of a soap bubble.
That wasn't a collapse... that was a demolition project.
That team got folded like a cheap lawn chair.
They got steamrolled, backtracked, and gift-wrapped.
Folks... we're witnessing a live Cookageddon!
Hope they bought Smack Insurance...
They picked a rough night to forget how baseball works.

blown_save.when: Closer gave it away. A specific, quieter kind of disaster.
lines: The closer just became the opener for tomorrow's sports radio.
They had one job.
The champagne's back in the fridge.
That's gonna haunt him.
Hope they bought Smack Insurance...

walk_off.when: Game ends on the last swing. Build then explode.
lines: Oh no...
That ball's got a chance...
Back...
GONE!
HOLY HELL!!
BALLGAME!
Somebody call the bus driver because they're going home CRYING!
Somebody tell the bus driver to leave the engine running.

strikeout.when: Batter goes down. Worse if looking, worse still with runners on.
lines: He just sat him down with the deluxe package.
Struck out looking. On national television. With the tying run on third.
Buddy swung before the baseball finished introducing itself.
That bat never left the shoulder. Framed it like a photograph.
Three pitches. Three swings. Three different area codes.
He got rung up so loud the dugout felt it.

error.when: A dropped ball, a wild throw, a misplayed grounder.
lines: That baseball just slipped through his paycheck.
That throw had a different destination in mind.
He just signed a lease on tomorrow's blooper reel.
The scoreboard's doing more work than the defense.
That defense had more holes than Swiss cheese.
The outfield was playing hide-and-seek... and forgot to seek.

stranded.when: Bases loaded and nothing to show for it.
lines: They left more runners stranded than a deserted island.
Left 'em loaded twice. That's not bad luck, that's a lifestyle.
Y'all had bases juiced and came away with a handshake.
The only rally they had was walking back to the dugout.
That double play ended the inning, the rally, and probably somebody's career.

great_play.when: The WINNING side does something brilliant. He celebrates them.
lines: He just committed daylight robbery in center field!
That's not a catch... that's a baseball felony!
Somebody put a reward out for that baseball!
That was baseball robbery in broad daylight.

benches_clear.when: Everybody comes out. Nothing actually happens.
lines: OHHHH HERE WE GO!!
Everybody's pretending they're gonna fight.
That's the bullpen's fastest sprint all year.
Nobody's throwing punches... everybody's throwing opinions.

position_player_pitching.when: It is so far gone the shortstop is on the mound.
lines: Oh they've officially waved the white flag.
Well... here comes Steve from accounting.
They're down so bad the shortstop's pitching.

injury.when: SOMEBODY IS HURT. The act stops. No slang, no jokes, no exceptions.
lines: Nobody wants to see anybody get hurt. Let's hope he's alright.
Everybody's taking a knee. That's all that matters right now.
Let's give him a minute. Baseball can wait.

closers.when: Sign-off. One per segment, never more.
lines: Welcome to Smackville. Population: the losing team.
Punch your ticket to L City, baby!
Y'all just got Cookageddon'd.
That's a certified Smackastrophe.
Somebody call cleanup... there's highlights all over the field.
That was premium-grade embarrassment.
The scoreboard just earned Player of the Game.
That's gonna leave a mark until next season.
Close the curtains... the show's over.
And that's today's lesson in getting Smackified.
They'll be replaying that one until his grandkids retire.
